baseline.title: Model-to-API Endpoint Mapping
baseline.description: Maps AI model families to supported API endpoints and includes maintained task-routing effort/context metadata for selected model IDs.

responses.description: Newer unified API for agentic, tool-using, and multimodal workflows. Required for GPT-5+ models; some older models (o1, o3, gpt-4o, gpt-4.1) support it alongside chat/completions.

chat_completions.description: Legacy conversational API. Being deprecated for newer models by end of 2026.

models.notes: Newest flagship model (Trusted Access Program rollout). Supports Chat Completions and Responses APIs.
GPT-6 tier balancing intelligence and cost. Supports both Chat Completions and Responses APIs per official model page.
GPT-6.1 tier balancing intelligence and cost (successor to gpt-6-sol). Supports both Chat Completions and Responses APIs, consistent with other GPT-6 tiers.
GPT-6 tier for cost-sensitive, high-volume use. Supports both Chat Completions and Responses APIs per official model page.
Responses API only (ResponsesModel-only Literal). Experimental/preview aliases not present in ChatModel.

Life sciences reasoning model, Trusted Access Program (approved organizations only). Responses API only, consistent with other restricted-access specialized models (gpt-daybreak-*, gpt-5.6-cyber). Billing begins October 5, 2026.
Responses API only (ResponsesModel-only Literal, not in ChatModel). More specific than gpt-5.6* pattern below.
Supports both endpoints. Includes gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna per OpenAI SDK ChatModel. gpt-5.6-cyber is responses-only (see separate entry above).
Responses API only (ResponsesOnlyModel per OpenAI OpenAPI spec). More specific than gpt-5.5* pattern below. Includes dated variants like gpt-5.5-pro-2026-04-23.
Supports both endpoints. Listed on the official GPT-5.5 model page. gpt-5.5-pro is responses-only (see separate entry above).

Supports both endpoints on OpenAI. GPT-5.4 routing metadata is exact-model only; mini/nano variants need separately verified data. The model page lists none, low, medium, high, and xhigh reasoning effort and a 1,050,000-token context window.
Responses API only per official model page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.3-codex). More specific than gpt-5.3* pattern below.
Supports both endpoints. Only gpt-5.3-chat-latest confirmed for both endpoints; gpt-5.3-codex is responses-only (see separate entry above). No bare gpt-5.3 base model exists.
Responses API only per official model page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.2-codex). More specific than gpt-5.2* pattern below.
Responses API only per official model page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.2-pro). More specific than gpt-5.2* pattern below.
Supports both endpoints. gpt-5.2-pro and gpt-5.2-codex are responses-only (see separate entries above).
Responses API only (ResponsesOnlyModel).

Responses API only per official model pages (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.1-codex, /gpt-5.1-codex-mini). More specific than gpt-5.1* pattern below. gpt-5.1-codex-max is covered by a dedicated entry above.
Supports both endpoints for gpt-5.1 and gpt-5.1-mini. gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-mini, and gpt-5.1-codex-max are responses-only (see separate entries above).
Responses API only for gpt-5-codex and gpt-5-pro (ResponsesOnlyModel). Includes dated variants like gpt-5-pro-2025-10-06.
Supports both endpoints for gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano.
Responses API only (ResponsesOnlyModel). Includes dated variants like o4-mini-deep-research-2025-06-26.
Reasoning model. o4-mini supports both endpoints (ModelIdsShared).
Responses API only. o3-pro and o3-deep-research are in ResponsesModel but not ChatModel.
Reasoning model. o3, o3-mini support both endpoints. o3-pro/deep-research use responses only (covered by separate entry above).
Responses API only. o1-pro is in ResponsesModel but not ChatModel.
Chat Completions API only per official model pages (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/o1-mini, /o1-preview). Not available via Responses API. More specific than o1* pattern below.
Reasoning model. o1 (base) supports both endpoints. o1-pro is responses-only and o1-mini/o1-preview are chat_completions-only (see separate entries above).
Responses API only. Specialized model for computer use tasks.
Responses API only per official model page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/codex-mini-latest). Chat Completions is marked unsupported on the model page.
Rolling alias for the latest ChatGPT-optimized GPT-4o model. Supports both endpoints (ModelIdsShared). Not matched by gpt-4o* pattern due to chatgpt- prefix.
Multimodal. Supports both endpoints. Includes audio and search preview variants.
Supports both endpoints. Includes gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4.1-nano.
Preview model. Now supports both endpoints per official model page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4.5-preview); Responses API support was added since the previous mapping update.
Legacy. In ModelIdsShared per OpenAI spec v2.3.0; supports both endpoints.
Legacy. In ModelIdsShared per OpenAI spec v2.3.0; supports both endpoints.
Legacy. In ModelIdsShared per OpenAI spec v2.3.0; supports both endpoints. Deprecated.

messages.description: Unified Messages API for all Claude models. Supports tool use, streaming, extended thinking, and vision.

Latest flagship family with verified 1M-token context windows and the Anthropic effort parameter.
Specialized models, invitation-only, with verified 1M-token context windows and the Anthropic effort parameter.
Best combination of speed and intelligence with verified 1M-token context windows and the Anthropic effort parameter.
Opus 4.6 and newer models have verified 1M-token context windows and support the Anthropic effort parameter.
Sonnet 4.6 has a verified 1M-token context window and supports the Anthropic effort parameter.
Fast/cheap Haiku generation 5 (claude-haiku-5-5). 1M token context window per official models overview; effort levels not verified, so no routing metadata.
Includes claude-haiku-4-5. Fast/cheap. 200K token context.
Previous generation. 200K token context.
Previous generation fast model.
Previous generation extended thinking model. 200K token context.
Previous generation. 200K token context.
